  "reasons": [
    "Under subscription occurs when the number of shares applied for is less than the number offered. As stated in NCERT Chapter 1 (Share Capital), allotment is confirmed only for the number of shares actually applied for (1,80,000 shares), provided minimum subscription has been received."
